detours.why: Blair Hall's mapped entrance is on its courtyard side to the east, and 11 University Place lies behind the hall to the west across University Place, so the walk goes round the end of Blair Hall and along University Place.

The paths mapped from Spelman Hall 7 leave the Spelman group northward, and McCarter Theatre's mapped door faces University Place to the south-west, so the walk goes north round the Spelman buildings and back down to it.
